inlines.v: WAVED, participle passive 1. Moved one way and the other; brandished. 2. Put off; omitted. 3. adjective In heraldry, indented. 4. Variegated in luster; as waved silk. 5. In botany, undate; rising and falling in waves on the margin, as a leaf.
